content.summary: Research findings for: mcp_opencode_task tool execution flow

data.original_input: Explore how the mcp_opencode_task tool works, including task tool definition, subagent execution, result flow, and MCP server integration.

codebase_findings.finding: Task tool definition with parameter schema, permission gating, session creation, metadata updates, and output packaging (includes <task_metadata> session_id).
Subtask execution path: SessionPrompt.loop detects subtask parts, creates a tool part, invokes TaskTool.execute with bypassAgentCheck, then marks tool part completed or error.
Subtask part schema contains prompt, description, agent, optional model, and command fields.
Subtask parts are created when commands are executed with subtask enabled; prompt text extracted from resolvePromptParts.
Session depth is computed at creation time (parent depth + 1) and used to gate delegation depth in TaskTool.
MCP tools are listed and keyed as sanitized client + '_' + tool name (e.g., opencode_task).
OpenCode tools (including task) are exposed to the Claude Agent SDK via an MCP server; MCP tools from external servers are re-exposed with a 'mcp_' prefix (mcp_opencode_task).
Claude Agent SDK wiring uses mcpServers.opencode and allows mcp__opencode__* tools; it normalizes tool names back to OpenCode IDs.

prior_art: No prior packets found in .agents/messages (directory was empty).
patterns: Tool.define + ToolRegistry used to expose tools to runtime and MCP bridges.
Subagent execution modeled as child Session with parentID and depth.
Progress surfaced through MessageV2.ToolPart updates via Bus events.
MCP tool naming is derived from client/tool names and then re-prefixed when bridged to SDKs.
raw_options: Run a minimal Task invocation to observe real metadata updates and tool naming in a live session.
Trace where tool metadata summaries are rendered/consumed in UI/SDK to see what progress is visible.
Add a structured progress channel for subagent text/step updates (beyond tool parts).
Unify or document tool name normalization (mcp_opencode_task vs mcp__opencode__task vs task) to reduce confusion.
Return structured task metadata separately from text to avoid parsing <task_metadata> blocks.
